profile_text.body:
Perplexity is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question.

Perplexity's tracked products include Perplexity AI, a search-augmented large language model accessible at its main website, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, an enterprise-oriented offering that the site characterizes as covering internal knowledge search, data indexing, single sign-on, and audit logs. The company also maintains a presence in the MCP server registry, with one server described as enabling real-time web search, reasoning, and research through Perplexity's API, and a second enabling web searches using Perplexity's Sonar Pro.

Perplexity carries a notable litigation footprint. Tracked cases include suits brought by The New York Times Company, Cable News Network Inc., Chicago Tribune Company LLC, and Encyclopaedia Britannica Inc. in the Southern District of New York, as well as matters involving Amazon.com Services LLC at both the Northern District of California and the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Additional cases involving parties named Gagleard and Noel have been filed in California federal courts. The held facts record 187 instances of legal exposure coded to California.
